arguments.query: EBS disk encryption by default at rest

answer:c228d841-cc85-4043-90c7-db80b6065: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
answer:57266435-a3f4-47d4-80db-8640866ac: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
